Coca Cola (KO) compounded revenue at 5.5% a year over 4 years. Did profitability keep up?

SEC financial snapshot · FY2025 (ended Dec 31, 2025)
• Revenue: $47.9B (+1.9% YoY)
• Operating margin: 28.7%
• Free cash flow: $5.3B (11.0% of revenue)

Latest quarter (ended Oct 2, 2026, 10-Q)
• Revenue: $13.4B (+7.4% vs the same quarter a year earlier)
• Operating margin: 33.4%

4-year view (FY2021 → FY2025)
• Revenue: $38.7B → $47.9B
• Operating margin: 26.7% → 28.7%

These are historical financial observations. They do not by themselves establish the drivers of growth, a research thesis or fair value.

Source: Coca Cola Form 10-K for FY2025, filed with the SEC on Feb 20, 2026. Reconcile figures to this filing.
